title: Egg Qorma
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Cooking oil 4 tbs or as required
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add sesame seeds,poppy seed and roast until fragrant & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein safeed til aur kashkhash dal dein aur khushbu anay tak roast ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In the same frying pan,add tomatoes and roast for 2-3 minutes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he frying pan mein tamatar dal dein aur 2-3 minutes kliya roast karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,onion and fry until golden brown & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooing oil aur pyaz dal ker golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In grinder,add fried onion,roasted tomatoes,roasted sesame & poppy seeds and grind well.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinder mein fried pyaz,roasted tamatar aur roasted safeed til aur kashkhash dal ker ache tarhan grind ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and grind to make a paste & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal dein aur grind ker ka paste tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In the same pot,heat cooking oil,add potatoes and fry until light golden.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he pot mein cooking oil garam karein aur aloo dal ker light golden hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add eggs,fry until light golden and take out for later use.
steps.romanUrdu: Anday dal dein aur light golden hunay tak fry karein aur bad mein use kerna kliya bahir nikal lein.

steps.instruction: Add bay leaves,cumin seeds,cloves,green cardamom,green chilies and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tez paat,zeera,laung,hari elaichi aur hari mirch dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste,mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add grinded paste,mix well and cook for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab grinded paste shamil karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add red chili powder,coriander powder and salt,mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Lal mirch powder,dhania powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein.
Pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add garam masala powder and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Garam masala powder dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Cover and cook on low flame for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur halki ancch per 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add boiled & fried eggs and mix gently.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab boiled & fried anday dal ker gently mix karein.
